pages.text: The pickups, the Off-Roader, the Minivan and the Farm Tractor have a $(l)tow ball$(). They pull the $(item)Camper$() and the $(item)Livestock Trailer$().$(br2)Put the trailer down, back up to its tongue so the ball is under the coupler, and press $(k:key.reikocars.hitch). Press it again to unhitch.
A camper on a pickup's ball: it swings round behind on bends.
